description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'List4' that displays a list of speeches using a custom ListAdapter 'SpeechListAdapter' and a custom view 'SpeechView'. It sources data from the 'Shakespeare' class and showcases the use of various Android UI components.

classes.name: List4
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays speeches using a custom adapter.

classes.name: SpeechListAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter for the list that inflates and binds speech data.

classes.name: SpeechView
classes.description: Custom view that displays a speech with a title and dialogue.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets a custom list adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of speeches from the Shakespeare data array.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as a simple placeholder object.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Uses the position as the unique ID for each list item.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a SpeechView for each list item and populates it with data.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text in the SpeechView.

methods.name: setDialogue
methods.description: Sets the dialogue text in the SpeechView.
